node_definition.done_when:
A measured dispatch-path regression from today's picker work. A peer session timed tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py::test_dispatch_returns_once_its_supervisor_runs on two git-archive extractions on node-local disk, each with a .venv symlink and a git repo, 10 runs each alone, alternating, at load about 30. Head 661b53a80 gave a dispatch_seconds median of 8.98 s (8.03–9.83), with 0 of 10 under the test's 8.0 s bound. Base 4d1feeed9 gave a median of 7.98 s (7.14–10.48), with 5 of 10 under. The median shift is +1.00 s, bootstrap 95% CI [+0.12, +1.72] s, exact two-sided p = 0.023. Report: ~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/reckon/dispatch-timing-one-fs.md (logs in run r-20261003T183406528525). The commits on reckon/crew/dispatch.py in that range are 88c10ba1d (persisted picker projections), ef9d41555 (picker decision outcomes, including hold recording) and the merge f1d34ca08. An import or first-use cost elsewhere on the path is also possible: for example, building the SQLite ledger index cold in a fresh home, or importing the picker and outcome modules.

1. Attribute the second. In a fresh process and a fresh fixture home, as the test does, time the dispatch path phase by phase at 4d1feeed9 and at the current head: imports, flight resolution, picker-input build (including any index creation), pick, plan_dispatch, worktree, launch. Use the same fixture as that test, run at least 5 times each, on node-local disk. Record the phase table in docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/dispatch-path-regression.html, with every figure from tool output.
2. Remove what the regression adds, without changing any picker input or selection. Recover the test's median to within 0.2 s of the base median under the same conditions. Plausible levers, to be confirmed by your measurement: defer the index build or projection read until a pick actually needs it; import picker and outcome modules lazily; never build picker inputs at all when the route will not consult the picker (an explicit lane, or deterministic routing). Equivalence of picker inputs against an uncached build must still hold, as tests/test_dispatch_speed.py already pins.
3. Do not change the test's 8.0 s bound. Whether that bound is right under fleet load is a separate question, and you may note it in follow_ons.

Gate: tests/test_dispatch_returns_without_worker.py, tests/test_dispatch_speed.py, tests/test_picker*.py and tests/test_ledger*.py. Run them with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 in the FOREGROUND, with one log for base and one for head under the run directory, each ending in an EXIT line, judged by delta. Also record the before and after median of test_dispatch_returns_once_its_supervisor_runs over 5 alone runs each. In reckon/crew/dispatch.py, edit only the picker-input functions, the picker call block and the hold-recording path.
